text: Entry Requirements High school graduation or higher education background. Requirements for English language. (a)Studied courses taught in English language and transcripts required. (b)>90 of TOEFL or >6 of IELTS (non-native English speakers). Applicants emigrating from mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao or Taiwan must hold a valid foreign citizenship for no less than 4 years and a record of residency in the country for no less than 2 years in the most recent 4 years. Under 65 years of age; exceptions can be considered for applicants with competitive academic background or those recommended by collaborative universities.
